newsitem.title: USA: CSCE world sugar called to open little changed.
newsitem.headline: CSCE world sugar called to open little changed.

text.p: CSCE world sugar was called to open mostly unchanged Friday, dealers said.

They expect benchmark July to cling to its recent trading range of 10.98 to 11.11 cents a lb. Firm support was seen at 10.92 and then at 10.85 cents, while an upside move over 11.20 could initiate further gains.
A lack of fundamental news should contribute to the dull tone, traders said.
Thursday, July contract closed off 0.04 cent at 11.01 cents after trading from the recent low of 10.98 to 11.08 cents. Second-position October settled 0.04 weaker at 10.81 cents.
An estimated 7,152 lots changed hands on the day.
LIFFE white sugar futures were down slightly in thin trade. At 0840 EDT/1340 GMT, spot August stood $0.50 lower at $317.50, while the outer months were unchanged to $0.70 lower.
